notes.title: Introducing Kitsune Tails!
notes.content:
No, this is not NEURODIVER, which we are still diligently working on, but we’d like to announce a delightful new game featuring classic platforming, magic & queer romance!

[previewyoutube=2XBSBUlc5Es;full][/previewyoutube]
In collaboration with another amazing queer game studio, Kitsune Games, the makers of the game MidBoss (coincidentally named, but not associated with us) and the even more famous Super Bernie World, we’re proud to announce development of our upcoming title Kitsune Tails, a platformer styled after beloved classics steeped in Japanese mythology and diverse relationships, coming to PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, as well as Windows and Linux via Steam and itch.io.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/4a82bde544214587d619dd74e6db57a81ca4dcbe.gif

Play as a young female kitsune, one of Inari’s fox-eared and bushy-tailed messengers, and embark on a hero’s journey that begins while delivering your first message. Experience a romantic encounter with a kindly sorceress who comes to your aid in a time of need. Explore the complicated relationship with your former mentor turned antagonist and uncover her reasons for sealing your love interest inside an elemental prison. Unlock powers that manifest as cute outfits to help you run, jump, and dash across five elemental worlds to save your love interest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/e2deaa15275dbd66faa5a531998e60380eb80e05.gif

Features
[olist]
 Classic platforming action set in a land inspired by Japanese mythology
 Explore five elemental worlds and various haunted houses
 Learn new elemental powers and use them to find secrets and optional story content
 Unlock a bonus ending by fully exploring the relationships between characters
 Use cute outfits to power up, stomp around by stealing a giant boot from enemies
 Defeat your haughty former mentor and her foxy gang of minions
 Stomp on pangos to make them curl into a ball, pick them up, and kick them around
 Carry lights through haunted houses to reveal secret doors and ward off ghosts
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37943051/748d370cc053e8610de7a8dd358d1e4e5619af13.gif

If you like what you see, you can find out more at kitsunetails.com or by visiting the Steam store page (wishlist it!), and of course you can always stay up-to-date by following the journey on Twitter.

As always, be sure to keep your augmented eyes on • our • social • media for further updates!

Until next time!
—MidBoss

notes.title: 2064 INTEGRAL Releases on the Nintendo eShop!
notes.content:
Get the Ultimate Edition of 2064!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/5b94781ac9cd5cf06973c48baace5e86ece04177.png
 
Howdy Cyberpunks!

As you might already know, 2064: Read Only Memories INTEGRAL went live on the Switch for pre-order a little over two weeks ago.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/2484a05ca4f3b7c0b941a639c133f00e0cff7792.jpg

We're excited to say that it's now fully available on the Nintendo eShop!
 
That's right, now you can play the coziest and most complete edition of 2064 yet with INTEGRAL. This is the swan song for 2064, bundling in all of the past extras into one neat package and one neat console, the Nintendo Switch!

It's been a long and winding road since the initial release of Read Only Memories back in October of 2015, and it feels right that the end of its journey is with the Switch. Get the best of both worlds playing on a big screen with a cozy couch, on the go in a cozy cafe, half asleep in a cozy bed. As mentioned before, this isn't just the INTEGRAL edition, it's also the (unofficially named) ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ COMPLETE 'N' COZY EDITION ฅ^•ﻌ•^ฅ.

It doesn't stop with the main game, though! INTEGRAL also includes a remastered side story, PUNKS, a twine game with a fresh coat of paint to blend in with the world of 2064. Play as Chad & Oliver and discover what they were up to before you meet them in the main game.

Other goodies include:

Sights of Neo-SF Digital Artbook
Sounds of Neo-SF Soundtrack / Jukebox
Movie Gallery
Main Cast Character Bios
Turing recolor names

All accessible through the in-game extras gallery!

So check it out and say farewell to the year 2064 with 2064: Read Only Memories INTEGRAL.

We hope you'll enjoy it!

===========================================================

Art Contest Winners

Last week we kicked off a fan art contest to build excitement for the launch of 2064 INTEGRAL, and we were blown away! There are two winners – MidBoss Choice vote and the Community Choice vote.

Let's see who won!
 
First up is the MidBoss Choice winner…DOTORIII

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/0f3806d3d4fb364e093835744f6be1cd554b9400.gif

We have an adorable animated Turing, feverishly playing something on their vintage Switch.

Who gave it to them, we wonder?

And our Community Choice winner is… Paku Daoust-Cloutier

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/4d8cb4e1cda8c63d08fcb085874f04f521d61876.jpg

The whole gang is here, featured stylishly in the lettering of 2064, cast on top of a lovely fuchsia and violet Neo-SF cityscape.

Very clever and cool!

Thanks so much to everyone that participated, and congratulations to DOTORIII and Paku!

All of the entries were awesome and really inspired. You can check the others out on our blog! 

And that does it for this week's update. Be sure to swing by the Nintendo eShop and check out 2064: Read Only Memories INTEGRAL, and big thanks again to everyone who participated in the art contest!

As always, be sure to keep your augmented eyes on • our • social • media.

See you in Neo-SF, cyberpunks!

- MidBoss

notes.title: 2064 on Xbox, Read Only Memories Type:M and 2064 for Switch!
notes.content:
Hey punks of the cyberverse! We have some exciting news, but first, a quick announcement: We’ve been working hard and at last we are ready to deliver the 2064: Read Only Memories experience to Xbox One owners today!


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/e1fc12ac3e07581d7769fb1d2b5727616d22241a.gif
No Xbox One X enchancements though..


Due to an error that will be corrected within 48 hours after launch, the price of 2064 on the Xbox Store will initially be set at $30, which is $10 above the normal price for all other platforms. We’re terribly sorry for the inconvenience and understand if you want to wait to buy until the price is changed to $20, but if you decide to purchase the game while it’s still at $30, e-mail us a receipt and we’ll send you an extra download code for your friend. Thank you for your understanding. 

And now, for some news!


http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/c6dcbe9134d5ee282acc1c2bbdfdb37cf8077bc9.png

After many trials and tribulations, we were finally able to make it happen: 2064 will also be releasing for iOS and Android as the long awaited 2064: Read Only Memories Type-M. We know that you have all been waiting patiently for this version to arrive, and while we couldn’t release it at first due to the original deal with OUYA and a few hiccups we hit along the way in getting the game to work on Vita, the time has arrived when Type-M has become a reality. 

To keep the size under 1GB, there will not be any voice acting, however it is a full version of the game that has all the same content as the PC, PS4, and XB1 versions as well as an updated bigger UI. Type-M will be launching in February and will have a free demo with a full unlock price of $6.99.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/7b9c3707b8497f2af17b107789a6b219cd463ebd.gif


Last, but certainly not least, by the end of March/early April we are launching on Nintendo Switch with an exclusive version titled 2064: Read Only Memories Integral. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/35bd8735582dfdc0ed879ea4718d8874037bf940.png

This final version will include a wide variety of new Extras content featuring: a 25 minute sidestory titled PUNKS, the Sights of Neo-SF art book, and the Sounds of Neo-SF soundtrack including extra songs that weren’t on the original soundtrack! Also, we’ve implemented full HD Rumble support for the main game. We hope that you’ll find this to be the ultimate version of 2064!


Thank you for all of your support! We love you all and want you to look forward to future prospects in the Read Only Memories Adventures Franchise. Until then, please continue to follow our social media pages for updates and keep sending us your fanart! 

Hit us up anytime on Twitter at @romadventure or @wearemidboss, or email us at info@midboss.com . 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/d5aff23abe38c74a24c6d3761a18426e9461ff53.png


Thanks!  

- Team MidBoss

notes.title: 4 Years since the original KS, and 2 Years since the original Launch! :O
notes.content:
Hey 'Punks!


It's been almost 4 years since our original Kickstarter ended! We've been working on this game for that long.


We have to start with a huge huge huge thank you. Thank you for believing in us. Thank you for putting your money into a game project from a first time game developer, thank you for believing that we could make this happen, and thank you for entrusting us. A lot has happened in those 4 years! 


We also want to apologize for the lack of communication and poor timeline execution -- we had to learn the hard way about a lot of the pitfalls of making your own game and we greatly overestimated our skill to amount of time ratio, and ended up falling short of a lot of our projections for release dates. This is something we can only promise to work hard on improving for the future, and we hope you'll continue to support us through our growing pains.


We've made a post detailing our present and future plans for 2064: Read Only Memories on our Kickstarter page, which you can read here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gaymercon/read-only-memories-a-tribute-to-90s-adventure-game/posts/2022537


The post details our overall plans for the game and its various ports, here's what you need to know for the Steam version.


- Before the end of November, the game will be released in Japan with full localization (but with English voices)! We have spent a long time working with PLAYISM in Japan to make sure our localization got things right.  We also got to go to TGS to show it off a month ago, and we had a lot of fun showing folks our near completed version of 2064:ROM JP.


We're really glad to have found a partner who understands the vision we had for the game and was committed to making sure it represented the cyberpunk and queer spirit we intended for the world. If you're in Japan or have friends who speak Japanese, please stay tuned. We believe the localization is a true extension of our vision. ːturingː


- Before the end of the year, the game will receive its final, FREE update that includes new voice acting scenes for Dekker, Turing, Lexi, Crow and Gordon, as well as the police ROMs, the hospital ROM and more! The aim was to fill in the major unvoiced gaps, as well a few surprises. It will also include bug fixes and content tweaks.


2064: Read Only Memories will be finally done, closing the book on our game. But worry not - we have begun work on a new Read Only Memories story! We hope you'll stick with us to see what's next, because we are super excited about what we have planned.


Please hit us up anytime at @rom2064 or @wearemidboss on Twitter, or email us at info@midboss.com!! Feel free to share your thoughts on our Steam forums as well! We want to talk to you!

notes.title: Just updated to 64.0.6b
notes.content:
Lots of bug fixes including some graphical errors in puzzles, small line edits, and small things that were wrong (now all the policeROMs have their own badge number!)

:turing:


We're about to release on X1 and in Japan, and we'll have some cool updates shortly, so stay tuned!


CHANGE LOG:

v64.0.6 & 64.0.6b // PSN v1.06 & v1.07

Lots of general bug fixes

New keyboard design and layout.

EN version Options Panel, Saves Panel and Warning screens have been updated to match the JP assets

Mega-P: Colored Power-Ups to make them easier to identify, and new Blast Away message during the last Boss wave. Tweaked timing on one of the waves.

Car Chase: Updated assets for the Stoplights menu to better match the new 2064 visuals.

Reverted dialogue changes to the Dekker Chase

Fixed a Crow animation

Taxi Button fixed for the Chase Car scene



(v64.0.5) // PSN v1.05

Fixed a bug where you would get stuck during a conversation in Chapter 6

Fixed a bug with LIPS//Live when using the Headphones.



(v64.0.4) // PSN v1.03/4

Fixed weird behaviour when skipping credits during Ending 1

Corrected Audiophile trophy requirements

Corrected Jobber trophy description

Fixed issues with Endless Christmas chapter

Updated credits

Turing recolors now properly load

notes.title: We're Going to BitSummit!
notes.content:
Hey all, how’s it going?


It’s the beginning of the month, so we thought it’d be a good time to remind you about our Patreon! We roll out all kinds of cool secrets over there that no one gets to see otherwise, including some extra info about our upcoming #GXEast17 Kickstarter we announced on Twitter. You can support for as little as $1, and the more you pledge the more cool stuff you get access to! Please consider supporting us today -- we’ll send you little cyberpunk hugs and love!

https://gallery.mailchimp.com/56b65e1f2b3ba5e696ffa9e29/images/75141ecf-4295-415e-a5ae-0a18e91e43b6.jpg


And hey, we're heading back to Japan! King Kronkus Matt Conn, 2064 Director JJSignal, and Good Boy Racoon Kossio will all be at BitSummit in May with the freshest build of 2064: Read Only Memories in Japanese. Considering how much work we’ve been putting into it, we’re super excited to let people see how far we’ve come since we were at Tokyo Game Show in September. We’ll let you know more about our booth location as soon as we can, so please come by and visit with us!

https://gallery.mailchimp.com/56b65e1f2b3ba5e696ffa9e29/images/ad2e5c65-74e6-4964-a5c2-8830e4ba2332.gif


Don’t forget to snag your preorder of the vinyl version of the 2064 OST while you still can. Those quantities are oh-so-limited so make sure you get one before they’re all gone forever: https://store.iam8bit.com/products/2064-read-only-memories-vinyl-soundtrack

Wanna keep up with us more often?  Follow us on Twitter, Like us on Facebook, and if you have any questions we'll answer them on our blog. Luv u 💙

notes.title: PUNKS: A 2064 Sidestory and Patch v64.0.5
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/e1d9d3aeb6806f69796eba42e855d4bf834a01af.png

Hey 2064 fans! Our company bear cub Philip Jones made a Twine game called “PUNKS: A 2064 Sidestory” starring Starfucker and Oliver for #ResistJam. It takes place in the Read Only Memories universe during chapter one of the main story. “PUNKS” is really fun and local Swiss good boy Ropnolc is behind the music, a few chiptune covers of 2064 songs! You can check out the game itself over on Itch, and the soundtrack is up on Soundcloud.
https://probearcub.itch.io/punks-a-2064-sidestory 
https://soundcloud.com/user-534946283/sets/punks-a-2064-side-story-ost

We’ve also just updated a new patch to 2064: Read Only Memories. We’re now up to v64.0.5, hurray! It fixes a bug where you would get stuck during a conversation in Chapter 6, a bug with LIPS//Live when using the Headphones, and descriptives now properly show up on PS4. It’s the most stable and best version yet -- so now is a great time to jump in if you haven’t already!

Wanna learn more about what we've been up to? We maintain a blog for a company so you can read all about what we're working on. Check it out: http://wearemidboss.tumblr.com/post/158711667829/hey-there-hows-it-going-since-we-last-wrote-to

notes.title: 2064: Read Only Memories is OUT
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9110833/cbd83ea07e5a14a93d5e75d9cebea6f553943095.gif

Greetings, CYBERPUNKS

The day has finally arrived: 2064: Read Only Memories is out now on PS4 and PC! Now you can enjoy this incredible update to our 2015 release Read Only Memories. What’s new? Full voice acting, updated puzzles, and a whole server farm worth of updates to the script, character emotions, music, and more!

We have nearly thirty voice actors, including BAFTA-nominated folks such as Melissa Hutchinson and Adam Harrington, huge game industry VO stars including Dave Fennoy and Erin Fitzgerald, gaming professionals like Jonathan Holmes and Zoe Quinn, and internet celebrities like Austin Creed (aka WWE’s Xavier Woods), Dan Ryckert, and Jim Sterling.
 
Not only that, but 2064: Read Only Memories also features: new and revamped puzzles! New animations! New characters! New areas to explore in the post-game “Endless Christmas” epilogue! Even more Hassy!!

There’s even an updated soundtrack and artbook for the deluxe version! Wow!

We've made an amazing new launch trailer to celebrate, watch it over here on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8JKVvRWT-Ew 

https://gallery.mailchimp.com/56b65e1f2b3ba5e696ffa9e29/images/b35d123b-da22-45bc-adcf-9b2e4dc5dc0b.jpg

notes.title: v1.1.1b Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixes
Fixed an issue causing some players to get a soft lock during a late-game sequence.
Fixed some variables that weren't being set properly on alternate paths.
Minor performance and stability fixes.
Minor text fixes and additions.

Known Issues

There are several known sporadic issues with Linux input that are being caused by some core Unity3D behavior. We are in the process of updating the project to Unity 5.3, which should fix them. If you're a Linux player and have been suffering, keep an eye out for an update soon!


v1.1.1b should be live in the next few minutes. Thank you for playing, and we can't wait to bring you some exciting stuff in 1.2 soon! 

Later Cyberpunks,

esdin
lead programmer | midboss

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
Hey C-Punks!

Quick update:

- We'll be at Playstation Experience on Dec 5 and 6 with some pretty big announcements!

- We'll be at GaymerX on Dec 11-13 with some more big announcements!

- We /hope/ to have ROM 1.2 ready for Christmas with a major new feature we've been working on that we think you'll really, really like. Without going too deep into it, we've dubbed it "Endless Christmas" - a day that you can spend exploring the city and hanging out with all the friends you've made in the city. This will only be unlockable if you get the "canon" ending, but will allow you to meet your old friends and...maybe..meet some new ones? :O

- Hassy-5

- Hassy-7

- Hassy Hot Cups

- OUYA codes are being sent out next week. Performance is not stellar. We tried our hardest, but its really not the optimal way to play, and if you can, we'd prefer you try it on computer unless you only own an OUYA and if that's the case, guh..sorry! We'll be sending you a free Steam/DRM-free code on top of the OUYA code to make up for it. Sorry :/

- We got a review on Gamespot! That's p cool.

notes.title: Read Only Memories Version 1.1 Is Here!
notes.content:
[code]Cyberlog: San Francisco, November 2015 A.D.[/code]

Hey there C-Punks!

Guess what! ROM 1.1 is HERE! This free update is now live like LIPS! We have a lot of very exciting things to show you, and this is only the first of our planned updates to the Read Only Memories world and lore. Below is our changelog of our major changes, but you may find some additional smaller changes, bug fixes, and tweaks throughout the game.


Mega Phobetor Arcade is now operational! That’s right, we added a whole new minigame! It even comes with its own achievement! Go to Stardust at any time and play to your heart’s content. (Gus and Majid had been a little lazy on the machine upkeep. Also: maintaining arcade machines is really hard.)

Added additional logic to how drinks and your diet preferences work together, including a brand new drink at the Stardust bar! (How long will it take you to find it on the… generous menu?)

New animations on the monitor in Market Street Ad Screen (Does VR kill love? Find out more at 11)

If TOMCAT respects you, you may be able to get some additional help solving the Login Puzzle, among other minor tweaks.

Over 500 new flavors of Hassy available in game. (Follow @hassyholdings for more info)

Added additional ROMs to opening cutscene.

Parallax to make $50M available to settle lawsuit -- NEO-SF - Parallax (PLLX) said Wednesday that it will make $50 million available to settle a wrongful death of a domestic animal suit, after a faulty ROM caused the death of a family corgi. This was an isolated incident, and can not be considered normal behaviour for a Relationship and Organizational Manager. 

A couple conversations have some pretty drastic changes! If you play through the game again, you might notice some key differences in certain scenes.

Numerous bug fixes and changes for optimal gameplay and plot progression.


“My Read Only Memories Brand Software isn’t showing 1.1!! WHAT DO I DO?!”

Don’t fret, it’s simple! Steam users will get the patch queued for download as soon as they open up Steam. Don’t have the internet? ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

If you have a DRM free version, first find whichever platform you purchased on (itch.io, Humble, GOG). itch.io has updated downloads RIGHT NOW and the game will be updated on GoG and Humble soon!

If you’ve got thoughts or questions about the game you’d like to make sure we see, email rombots@midboss.com, post in the Steam Discussion forums, or post on the official MidBoss forums and get in touch with the community! We want our game to be able to grow in a way that works best for our existing user base and makes things easier for those who are coming in. 

Oh by the way! If you’re looking for the hottest way to jan out to the game’s tunes, don’t miss the brand new LYRIC VIDEO to Love Me Better, the game’s official credits theme! Featuring super awesome gamer rapper SAMMUS! She's amazing, check it out.

And while you’re at it, we’ve started our own wiki for the game that has been really shaping up lately due to fan contribution!

Thanks again for your support over the last month. It has been astoundingly positive. Please enjoy Read Only Memories 1.1, and stay tuned for details in the future about upcoming patches, updates, and so on.  (-`♡´-) 

Stay Hassy,
The Read Only Memories dev team
